summary: Web Audio got a trio of fixes: the SSE4.2 configuration typo was corrected (ensuring correct use of CPU SIMD optimisations), repeated OfflineAudioContext.startRendering() promise rejections are handled safely during fuzz/crashtests, and multichannel Vorbis channel ordering in ffvpx’s libvorbis wrapper was fixed so surround-channel layouts map correctly. These changes improve offline rendering stability and correct multi-channel audio playback fidelity.
